name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of Private-Coordinate Cubes
proof: Give $h_v$ the singleton teacher $\{(p_v,1)\}$. Every other concept labels $p_v$ zero, so these are ordinary teaching sets and in particular form a no-clashing assignment. Width zero is impossible for a class with at least two concepts: two empty teachers would clash. Thus NCTD is exactly one.
references: \cite{KSZ2019}, Proposition 28(1), and the explicit private-positive teaching assignment above.
